GlobalSettings.Privacy.Message.Current:
Last updated: August 25, 2026

Overview
Noctra is a media player and playlist organizer. It does not provide, host, sell, rent, broadcast, or include media content or IPTV subscriptions.

Information You Provide
The app may store profile details, protected PIN data, provider and source credentials, preferences, favorites, hidden categories, history, progress, downloads, program guide settings, Premium entitlement, and promotion-code state.

Local Storage
Settings, databases, logs, temporary data, and downloads are stored on your device, primarily under Documents\Noctra and selected download folders. Sensitive values use Windows protection where supported. Noctra does not sell personal information or build advertising profiles from viewing activity.

Network Connections and Third-Party Services
The app connects to providers, playlists, streams, program guide, metadata, update, and Microsoft Store services only to perform requested actions. Those services may receive IP addresses, headers, credentials, and requested resources and apply their own policies.

Diagnostics, Bug Reports, and Crash Reports
Noctra does not silently send reports. A report opens an editable email draft that may include app and system details, error information, stack traces, and a device-specific diagnostic identifier. Nothing is sent until you send it.

Microsoft Store Purchases and Reviews
Microsoft handles purchases, payments, taxes, refunds, reviews, and entitlements. Noctra does not directly process payment-card data.

Data Retention and Deletion
Local data remains until removed. You may clear app data or delete Documents\Noctra and custom download folders. Uninstalling may not remove those files. Support emails may be retained for support, security, abuse prevention, and legal obligations.

Data Sharing
Kynora Studio does not sell or rent personal information. Data is shared only at your direction, through voluntary support reports, when legally required, or to protect users, rights, and security.

Security
Reasonable local safeguards are used, but no storage or transmission is completely secure. You are responsible for protecting your account, device, credentials, playlists, and sources.

Changes
This policy may change with application behavior, Store requirements, or legal obligations.

Contact
Privacy, deletion, or support questions: kynora.studio@gmail.com

GlobalSettings.Privacy.Message.Mobile:
Last updated: August 25, 2026

Overview
Noctra for Android is a media player and playlist organizer. It does not provide, host, sell, rent, broadcast, or include media content, TV channels, movies, series, playlists, EPG data, streaming links, or IPTV subscriptions.

Information Stored on Your Device
The app stores profile names, avatars, PIN data, provider and source credentials (usernames, passwords, server addresses, MAC addresses), preferences, favorites, hidden categories, watch history, playback progress, download items, program guide settings, and Premium or promotion-code state in a local database and settings files on your device.

Local Storage and Credential Protection
Noctra has no account system: your profiles, watch history, downloads, and playlists are never uploaded or synced by us. Sensitive values such as provider passwords, PIN data, and promotion grants are encrypted on device using Android Keystore-backed AES-GCM where supported.

Advertising in the Free Version
The free version shows banner and interstitial ads; Premium removes them.
- On devices with Google Play services, ads come from Google AdMob via the Google Mobile Ads SDK. Per Google's disclosure, that SDK may collect and share device identifiers (such as the advertising ID), IP address, product interaction data, and diagnostics with Google and advertising partners for advertising, analytics, and fraud prevention.
- On Huawei devices without Google Play services, ads come from Huawei Petal Ads (HMS Ads Kit), which applies its own SDK data practices.
Ads are personalized only where a valid consent choice exists; otherwise non-personalized ads may be shown.

Consent
Before any ad SDK initializes, Noctra asks you to accept its legal notice on first launch. Where required, for example in the EEA/UK, Google's User Messaging Platform (UMP) or the Huawei consent dialog then records your ad-personalization choice, and you can revisit that choice from the in-app privacy options or by resetting or deleting your advertising ID in system settings.

Provider Connections
The app connects only to services you configure: provider portals, playlist and stream URLs, EPG sources, and logos. Those services receive your IP address, request headers, and the credentials you configured for them. Many IPTV sources use unencrypted http:// connections; the app permits cleartext traffic for this reason, so data to and from such sources may travel without encryption.

Metadata (TMDB)
To show posters, backdrops, and details, the app sends searched titles and your language preference to The Movie Database (TMDB) with adult content excluded. TMDB receives your IP address and the queried titles; these requests are not linked to your profiles.

Purchases, Subscriptions, and Backend Verification
Payments are processed by Google Play; Kynora Studio never receives your card data. To verify Premium entitlement, the app sends your purchase token, product ID, and package name to the Kynora Studio verification backend, which validates them with Google and returns the result. The backend is stateless: it stores no installation identity and no profile data. Your IP address is visible to it as with any internet service. Promotion codes are validated through the backend and stored only on your device in encrypted form.

Retention and Deletion
Your data stays on your device until you remove it: clear the app's data, uninstall the app, or delete its storage folder. Uninstalling removes app-private data; files in download folders you selected may remain. Support emails are retained for support, security, abuse prevention, and legal obligations.

Data Sharing
Kynora Studio does not sell or rent personal information. Data is shared only as you direct through provider and metadata requests, by the advertising SDKs described above under your consent choices, in voluntary support reports, when legally required, or to protect users, rights, and security.

Security
Reasonable measures protect local data, but no storage or transmission is completely secure. Many provider sources are unencrypted by nature; protect your device, credentials, lists, and sources.

Changes
This policy may change with app behavior, store requirements, or legal obligations.

Contact
Privacy, deletion, or support: kynora.studio@gmail.com
